name: Full sales cycle - greeting to payment
description: Complete sales cycle: greeting, discovery, quote, objection, close, payment request.

messages.text: Hi there! I'm building kitchen cabinets and need melamine boards.
I need about 12 sheets of 16mm white melamine. What's the price?
That's a bit more than I expected. Is there any discount for 12 sheets?
OK, I'll take it. Can you send me a payment link? I'm in Springs.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle price objection with value
